# 禮法華經儀式

**ID:** T1944
**Volume:** T46
**Category:** 法華部類
**Original Category:** 諸宗部
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1944

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* anonymous liturgical procedure (*yíshì* 儀式) for the worship and recitation of the Lotus Sūtra, belonging to the standard Tiāntái Lotus liturgical apparatus alongside [KR6d0191](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0191)–[KR6d0193](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0193). The work provides ritual instruction for the lay-and-monastic recitation-and-veneration practice of the Lotus Sūtra.

**Abstract**

The composition is bracketed loosely within the post-Zhànrán productive period for *Fǎhuá*-related liturgical material (c. 750–1100).
